alpinemedia.tokenSource: the token is NOT in the repository: set ALPINEMEDIA_TOKEN_MIDDLEBURY_SNOWBOWL in liftie's environment (liftie.service Environment=). Its value is the public client key (expo config extra.apiKey) in https://ski-middlebury.app.alpinemedia.com/static/js/775.0d9fd686.js, loaded by https://ski-middlebury.app.alpinemedia.com/embed/lifts-trails/conditions; read 2026-11-17. The org header must be middlebury-snowbowl (ski-middlebury answers an empty board).
alpinemedia.rotates: may change with any app release: a 401, an empty board or an unset variable is an error; re-read the key from the current bundle and update the variable
